examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the Application Accelerator page places it: the overline, the left-aligned headline and its supporting sentence, then six icon-led use cases in a three-column divider grid, each linking out to the page that explains it. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no items renders nothing at all.

examples.name: Without links
examples.summary: Items with no `href` render as plain topics: the same left-aligned title over a three-column divider grid, with nothing to follow. Link every item or none.

site.name: Topics
site.summary: Six linked cells from the Application Accelerator page. Each cell shows an arrow on its headline because it has a link.
